text: The pie chart illustrates how the budget of one city council was divided between six areas of spending in 2024, expressed as percentages of total spending.

Overall, services for people, namely schools and social care, took up the largest part of the budget, accounting for more than half of all spending. The remaining four areas each received a much smaller share, ranging from 9% to 14%.

Schools and education were the single largest item of expenditure, at 31% of the budget, followed by social care, which accounted for just over a quarter (26%). Together, these two services used 57% of the money the council spent.

Roads and transport came third, with 14%, while housing support made up 11%, so these two areas together accounted for a quarter of the budget. The two smallest areas of spending, waste collection and parks and leisure, received exactly the same share, 9% each. This means that the council spent less than a third as much on parks and leisure as it did on schools and education.

note.en: Introduces the overview — the big picture without numbers.
note.ru: Открывает overview — общий итог без цифр.

note.en: Specifies exactly which services are meant.
note.kk: Қандай қызметтер нақты айтылып отырғанын нақтылайды.
note.ru: Уточняет, какие именно услуги имеются в виду.

note.en: Places the second item after the first.
Combines two items into one share.
note.ru: Объединяет две статьи в одну долю.

note.en: A conclusion: the total of two items.
A conclusion from comparing the smallest and largest items.
note.kk: Ең кіші және ең ірі бапты салыстырудан шығатын қорытынды.
note.ru: Вывод из сравнения самой маленькой и самой большой статьи.

strengths.en: The six sectors are described in pairs — large, medium, small — rather than one by one.
strengths.kk: Алты бөлік жеке-жеке емес, жұппен сипатталған — ірі, орташа, кіші.
strengths.ru: Шесть секторов описаны парами — крупные, средние, мелкие, — а не по одному.
strengths.example: so these two areas together accounted for a quarter of the budget

strengths.en: The two equal sectors are noticed and described in one phrase: “exactly the same share”.
strengths.kk: Бірдей екі бөлік байқалып, бір тіркеспен сипатталған: «exactly the same share».
strengths.ru: Два одинаковых сектора замечены и описаны одной фразой: «exactly the same share».
strengths.example: received exactly the same share, 9% each

strengths.en: “Less than a third as much … as” compares the smallest and largest items precisely.
strengths.kk: «less than a third as much … as» — ең кіші және ең ірі бапты дәл салыстыру.
strengths.ru: «less than a third as much … as» — точное сравнение самой маленькой и самой большой статьи.
strengths.example: less than a third as much on parks and leisure

strengths.en: Took up, accounted for, made up, received, spent — without repeating “was”.
strengths.kk: took up, accounted for, made up, received, spent — «was»-ты қайталамай.
strengths.ru: took up, accounted for, made up, received, spent — без повторов «was».
strengths.example: took up the largest part of the budget

note.en: What the chart shows and how many areas of spending. “Annual budget” → “budget … divided between six areas”.
note.kk: Диаграмма нені көрсетеді және шығыстың неше бабы бар. «annual budget» → «budget … divided between six areas».
note.ru: Что показывает диаграмма и сколько статей расходов. «annual budget» → «budget … divided between six areas».

note.en: The two main items together make more than half; the rest are smaller, with their range given (9–14%).
note.kk: Екі басты бап бірге — жартысынан көбі; қалғандары азырақ және олардың шегі аталған (9–14 %).
note.ru: Две главные статьи вместе — больше половины; остальные меньше, и названа их граница (9–14 %).

note.en: The two largest items and their total: 31 + 26 = 57.
note.kk: Ең ірі екі бап және олардың қосындысы: 31 + 26 = 57.
note.ru: Две крупнейшие статьи и их сумма: 31 + 26 = 57.

note.en: The smaller items in pairs, with a total (14 + 11 = 25, “a quarter”) and a comparison with the largest.
note.kk: Кішірек баптар жұппен, қосындысымен (14 + 11 = 25, «a quarter») және ең ірісімен салыстырылған.
note.ru: Меньшие статьи — парами, с суммой (14 + 11 = 25, «a quarter») и сравнением с самой крупной.
